workspace.description: The workspace whose setup it is, by the slug list_workspaces answered.

repository.description: The repository whose setup script to save, as owner/name.

target.description: The script to save: kind workspace for the workspace's install script, which runs once in each build of a repository's base snapshot; or kind repository with repository, as owner/name, for that repository's setup script, which runs once in each new agent sandbox of it.

script.description: The whole script, which replaces the one that stood; an empty one removes it.
